answers.how: Tracked the spacecraft across frames to estimate an acceleration of about 221 px/s². The prior gives a scale of 4/221 m/px; its length is about 338 px.
Using the acceleration-derived scale of 4/221 m/px, the spacecraft's approximately 108 px height converts to 1.95 m.
The tracked motion is approximately constant acceleration from rest. With acceleration 4 m/s², the speed at 0.5 s is 2 m/s.
The tracked motion is approximately constant acceleration from rest. With acceleration 4 m/s², the speed at 1.0 s is 4 m/s.
